visualConsistency.characterIdentity: Coach Kai (Fictional Kinetix Digital Movement Specialist)

visualConsistency.footwear: Minimalist black athletic training shoes with amber sole accents
visualConsistency.studioSetting: Dark minimalist radial graphite gradient (#1A1A1E to #0E0E10)

demonstration.startPosition: Feet shoulder-width apart, toes turned outward 15–30°, upright torso, arms balanced forward.
demonstration.movement: Simultaneously hinge hips down and back while flexing knees, keeping weight centered midfoot.
demonstration.endPosition: Hip crease breaks below the top of the patella, maintaining a neutral lumbar curvature.
demonstration.primaryFormCue: Track knees directly over middle toes; maintain proud chest throughout descent.
demonstration.commonMistake: Knees collapsing inward (valgus collapse) or heels elevating from the floor.

demonstration.primaryTarget: Pectoralis Major, Anterior Deltoids, Triceps Brachii
demonstration.startPosition: Hands slightly wider than shoulder-width, fingers spread, rigid straight-line plank from heels to crown.
demonstration.movement: Lower chest smoothly toward floor with elbows tucked at roughly 45° to the ribcage.
demonstration.endPosition: Chest hovers 1–2 inches above floor; elbows past 90° flexion; core braced rigid.
demonstration.primaryFormCue: Screw hands firmly into ground to engage lats and stabilize shoulder capsules.
demonstration.commonMistake: Sagging lower back, flaring elbows out perpendicular (90°), or craning neck forward.

demonstration.primaryTarget: Latissimus Dorsi, Biceps, Rhomboids, Lower Trapezius
demonstration.startPosition: Overhand grip slightly wider than shoulders, arms fully extended in an active dead hang.
demonstration.movement: Depress and retract scapulae, drive elbows down and back to hoist chest toward the bar.
demonstration.endPosition: Chin clears the bar cleanly without cervical extension; chest touches or nears bar height.
demonstration.primaryFormCue: Think about driving your elbows into your back pockets rather than curling with arms.
demonstration.commonMistake: Kicking legs or kipping body for momentum; rounding shoulders forward at the top.

demonstration.primaryTarget: Hamstrings (Biceps Femoris), Gluteus Maximus, Erector Spinae
demonstration.startPosition: Stand tall with feet hip-width, weights resting against anterior thighs, shoulders pinned back.
demonstration.movement: Unlock knees slightly and push hips straight backward as if closing a door behind you.
demonstration.endPosition: Weights reach mid-shin with maximum tension felt along hamstrings and glutes; spine neutral.
demonstration.primaryFormCue: Keep dumbbells brushing along thighs and shins; movement is purely horizontal hip travel.
demonstration.commonMistake: Squatting with knee bend rather than hinging hips; rounding thoracic or lumbar spine.

demonstration.startPosition: Stand tall with feet together, hands on hips or holding dumbbells at sides.
demonstration.movement: Step forward deliberately, planting heel-to-toe and lowering trailing knee straight down.
demonstration.endPosition: Both knees achieve approximately 90° angles; trailing knee hovers 1 inch above floor.
demonstration.primaryFormCue: Keep torso vertical with equal weight distribution between front heel and back ball of foot.
demonstration.commonMistake: Taking too short a stride causing forward knee shearing over toes; leaning torso forward.

demonstration.startPosition: Stand tall with dumbbells at sides, arms extended, palms facing forward or neutral.
demonstration.movement: Pin elbows to ribcage and flex elbows upward, supinating wrists as weights ascend.
demonstration.endPosition: Full bicep contraction at shoulder height without moving elbows forward or backward.
demonstration.primaryFormCue: Keep elbows locked at sides; isolate tension without using torso sway or hip drive.
demonstration.commonMistake: Swinging torso for momentum; shifting elbows forward to cheat mechanical tension.

demonstration.primaryTarget: Rectus Abdominis, Transverse Abdominis, Internal & External Obliques
demonstration.startPosition: Forearms on floor with elbows directly under shoulders, feet hip-width apart.
demonstration.movement: Engage core, squeeze glutes, press forearms firmly into ground, and hold rigid line.
demonstration.endPosition: Continuous isometric hold with neutral pelvis, active lats, and flat thoracic spine.
demonstration.primaryFormCue: Pull elbows toward toes isometrically to maximize deep abdominal recruitment.
demonstration.commonMistake: Hyperextending lumbar spine (sagging hips); piking glutes into the air.

demonstration.startPosition: Stand tall with feet together, arms resting relaxed at sides.
demonstration.movement: Jump feet outward slightly wider than shoulder-width while sweeping arms overhead.
demonstration.endPosition: Hands clap or meet above head, feet wide; immediately spring back to start position.
demonstration.primaryFormCue: Land softly on balls of feet with knees slightly unlocked to absorb joint impact.
demonstration.commonMistake: Stiff-legged heavy heel landing; flailing arms without full shoulder range.
